Import approved runtime/model assets under documented OS network isolation. Disabling a downloader alone is not equivalent. Check embedded policies, resources, schemas, licenses, migrations, and verifier. Hash actual installed artifacts.

requirements.title: Installed qualification and endurance
requirements.requirement_text: Exercise observation, intake, continuity, reasoning, shadow preparation, review, authority, effect, readback, memory, restart, and next-session explanation. Repeat with denial, stale state, worker/model failures, privacy limits, and interruption after effect. Test upgrade from supported schemas and uninstall with deliberate retention. Inspect UI evidence where useful.

requirements.title: Installed qualification and endurance
requirements.requirement_text: Run a seven-day controlled campaign after earlier gates pass, using approved low-risk resources and finite grants. Include actual tasks and injected faults; measure cumulative history, performance, authority, recovery, data preservation, and semantic failures. Accelerated time is not elapsed-time endurance. If the session cannot complete seven days, deliver the real harness/checkpoint and open gate without claiming background operation.

requirements.title: Installed qualification and endurance
requirements.requirement_text: The initial qualified profile is a whole coherent system within bounded scope. It cannot omit mandatory core controls. Hardware-backed, distributed-authority, modality, and physical lanes keep their requirements and separate evidence states. Profile-qualified delivery and completion of every long-term requirement are different status fields.

requirements.title: Supply chain, packaging, and updates
requirements.requirement_text: Build from recorded source and pinned dependencies/toolchain with manifests, licenses, and SBOM. Keep training dependencies outside the desktop closure when unnecessary for runtime. Recheck actual advisories and retain findings rather than suppressing them. Inspect libraries loaded by the frozen executable.

requirements.title: Supply chain, packaging, and updates
requirements.requirement_text: Produce installer, offline asset route, required dependency/source companion, verification bundle, and reproducible recipe. Distinguish reproducible instructions from demonstrated bit-for-bit builds. Bind source, executable, installer, assets, and evidence separately. Matching version labels cannot prove that an installer contains newer source.

requirements.title: Supply chain, packaging, and updates
requirements.requirement_text: Preserve the documented personal publisher-verification choice unless superseded by an explicit owner decision. Publisher keys remain separate from runtime, custody, and audit identities. Generic build permission does not authorize using/exporting/rotating private production keys. Validate channel, bytes, compatibility, freshness, rollback, and migration before updating. Do not alter trust stores or suppress OS warnings to imply trust.

requirements.title: Supply chain, packaging, and updates
requirements.requirement_text: Updates are governed maintenance with quiescence, backup, verified activation, health checks, and rollback. Failure preserves user data and a recoverable previous state. Public release, website edits, distribution, uploads, paid services, and production signing require applicable current authorization. Implementation authorization is not automatic publication authorization.

requirements.title: Supply chain, packaging, and updates
requirements.requirement_text: Give the rebuild an unambiguous development version distinct from the installed legacy release. Preserve separate source, package, application, schema, policy, and model versions where their meanings differ. Do not reuse an old release tag or rename an old installer to suggest it contains the rebuild. Resolve the production release number at the authorized release gate and verify source-to-binary-to-installer correspondence.

requirements.title: Implementation and coordination
requirements.requirement_text: Assign one lead integrator accountable for the whole contract. Scope actual available implementation, review, security, testing, and documentation workers through an ownership ledger. Parallelize only non-overlapping work under frozen interfaces. Never fabricate independent agent reviews. Attribute evidence, changes, findings, and dissent.

requirements.title: Implementation and coordination
requirements.requirement_text: Start with preservation, source reconciliation, and the full contract. Build a functioning skeleton containing the real store, kernel, IPC, supervisor, and one bounded effect. Extend that same cycle with context, memory, reasoning, graph, qualified inference, custody, migration, and native workflows. Test seams as they become real. Every control needed for an exposed effect must already operate.

requirements.title: Implementation and coordination
requirements.requirement_text: Retire duplicate live responsibilities deliberately. Move every caller of old permit issuers and prompt builders. Memory cannot use a legacy chat database as another authority. Each consolidation proves callers migrated and bypass removed. Historical compatibility is confined to explicit boundaries.

requirements.title: Implementation and coordination
requirements.requirement_text: Keep a durable work ledger linking requirements, owners, implementation, tests, status, and next action. At session boundaries, capture unfinished work, hashes, active processes, assumptions, commands, and blockers. Reopen invalidated gates. Never shrink the assignment to the portion completed in one session.
requirements.evidence_limits: Source summary/read-snapshot integrity is partial specification-tool evidence only; original source reconciliation, semantic adequacy, unified executable contract and runtime acceptance remain open.

requirements.title: Required artifacts and commands
requirements.requirement_text: Maintain a rebuild charter; source/authority register; twenty-volume coverage; requirement/implementation/test matrix; system contract; ownership/dependency/trust maps; architecture decisions; threat/assumption registers; schemas/migrations; capability/model qualification; budgets; fixtures/runners; independent verifier; cutover/build/install/update/rollback runbooks; user guide; and truthful continuity map. Use established locations or justified equivalents. Do not produce rival registries for the same authority.
requirements.evidence_limits: Declared allocation/reference/cycle tooling is partial specification evidence; all actual runtime/interfaces/full source/acceptance obligations remain open. Bounded original-record framing is pure source evidence only; all remaining clauses, authenticated transport, current authority and runtime qualification remain open. Pure memory metadata binding is partial contract evidence only; owning memory/privacy domain implementation is not advanced by this leaf, and authentic authority/current store/copy deletion/restoration/full-runtime obligations remain open. Source summary/read-snapshot integrity is partial specification-tool evidence only; original source reconciliation, semantic adequacy, unified executable contract and runtime acceptance remain open.

requirements.title: Required artifacts and commands
requirements.requirement_text: Provide working commands for discovery, setup, contract/integration/security tests, real inference, installed offline validation, performance, migration rehearsal, build, verification, and launch. Final commands refer to actual files and were exercised where claimed. Existing verify_desktop_runtime.py and verify_all.py are leads whose present interfaces must be inspected. Implement one orchestrating verification entry point with readable and machine-readable outputs, without rewriting history.

requirements.title: Required artifacts and commands
requirements.requirement_text: Evidence binds source before/after, actual interpreter/libraries, model/template, hardware, policy/graph, fixture/seed, commands, outputs, failures, effects, skips, and package. Keep first failures separate from repairs. Label source-only, UI, real-model, installed, network-isolated, hardware-backed, independently reviewed, and elapsed-time evidence.

requirements.title: Completion gates
requirements.requirement_text: Gate A: preserve baseline, identify source conflicts, cover all twenty Codex volumes, and freeze an implementable unified contract. Gate B: new store, kernel, supervisor, observation, and effect operate together with success and denial tests. Gate C: context, memory, Companion, graph, authority, and verification complete the real cycle. Gate D: actual containment/custody/privacy profiles pass technical gates or remain visibly unavailable with requirements open.
requirements.evidence_limits: Declared allocation/reference/cycle tooling is partial specification evidence; all actual runtime/interfaces/full source/acceptance obligations remain open.

requirements.title: Completion gates
requirements.requirement_text: Gate E: migrate and recover without lost or silently rewritten data. Gate F: exact installed offline bytes pass the approved semantic, performance, UI, hostile, and lifecycle profile. Gate G: real endurance and required independent/hardware reviews complete. Gate H: separately authorized production cutover/publication. Every later gate rechecks applicable earlier guarantees.

requirements.title: Completion gates
requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate: select a project, establish scope, notice a real change, explain it from evidence, prepare work, deny an unauthorized variant, authorize a valid variant, perform/read back/settle, survive interruption, and resume accurately later. The workspace and application records must agree. All enabled controls and capabilities must participate.

requirements.title: Completion gates
requirements.requirement_text: Full completion means all mandatory agreed-scope requirements have their required evidence. Disabling a required feature does not complete it. A narrower qualified profile must not be relabeled full completion. External dependencies retain mandatory status, required intervention, affected gates, and safe completed work.

requirements.title: Blockers and final handoff
requirements.requirement_text: Blocker records state ID, requirement, observed cause, evidence, impact, minimum resource/decision, dependencies, and safe continuing work. Missing access, secure hardware, enforcement support, independent review, quality, or elapsed duration must be represented accurately. Difficulty is not a blocker by itself. Relevant historical defects cannot be dismissed as merely pre-existing.

requirements.title: Blockers and final handoff
requirements.requirement_text: Before delivery, attack bypasses, duplicate authority, false independence, loops, fake completion, migration loss, hidden egress, invalid security claims, dead controls, stale evidence, and unusable commands. Repair within scope and rerun affected gates. Preserve recoverability. Improve the evidence rather than the adjective attached to status.

requirements.title: Blockers and final handoff
requirements.requirement_text: Final report fields: Mode; Baseline; Architecture decisions; Created; Modified; Retired production paths; Preserved history; Migration result; Commands executed; Tests passed; Failed; Skipped; Not run; Independent review; Hardware evidence; Installed qualification; Endurance; Remaining mandatory work; Risks; Artifact paths/hashes; Continuity; Safe to continue. State exactly what the installed result enables. Begin with workspace inspection and implementation, not another request to plan this same rebuild.
